# 💬 Support for Paperly

Thanks for using Paperly! Here's how to get the help you need, fast.

## 🐛 GitHub Issues — For Bugs and Features Only

**Use [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/abir2afridi/Paperly/issues/new/choose) for:**

- 🐛 Reporting bugs you've found
- ✨ Proposing new features
- 📝 Reporting documentation problems

**Do NOT use GitHub Issues for:**

- ❓ Questions about how to use Paperly
- 🤔 Help with your specific setup or configuration (env vars, Supabase, collab server)
- 💬 General discussion

Using Issues for support questions clutters the bug tracker and slows
down development. Please use the channels below instead.

## 💬 Community Support Channels

- **GitHub Discussions** — https://github.com/abir2afridi/Paperly/discussions
  (questions, ideas, and community discussion)

> 💡 If Discussions is not yet enabled on the repository, ask in the
> [💬 Question / Support issue form](https://github.com/abir2afridi/Paperly/issues/new?template=15-question.yml)
> instead — we'll answer there.

## 📖 Documentation

Before asking for help, check the documentation:

- [README](https://github.com/abir2afridi/Paperly#readme) — features, setup, and env vars
- [docs/ folder](https://github.com/abir2afridi/Paperly/tree/main/docs) — feature plan,
  AI providers, security model, compilation

## 🔍 Search First

Before posting anywhere, please search:

1. [Existing GitHub Issues](https://github.com/abir2afridi/Paperly/issues)
2. [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/abir2afridi/Paperly/discussions)
3. The [documentation](https://github.com/abir2afridi/Paperly/tree/main/docs)
4. [Closed issues](https://github.com/abir2afridi/Paperly/issues?q=is%3Aclosed)
   (many answers live in closed issues)

## ⏱️ Response Times

We are volunteers. Please be patient:

- GitHub Issues: 48–72 hours
- Community channels: best-effort from the community
